text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I was so surprised this morning~! To think 
everyone at the dorm treated me to a 
home-cooked breakfast!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, everyone's been raring to go since 
yesterday. They really want to make Ryan 
happy—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...For what it's worth, I tried making 
some food too. Just stuff like chicken 
steak and soy milk cake, though."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy...! Not just for me, but to 
think you care so much about my muscles, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Dober, you truly understand me so well...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-It's not that big of a deal, but――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still... yeah, you're right. I feel like I 
know Ryan pretty well.
